outline: 本課程提供理工學者撰寫科技論文之英文寫作技巧與指導，內容包括：扼要複習英文文法，詳細說明撰寫英文研究報告或論文時常犯的錯誤，深入討論標準英文寫作風格與修辭原則，提供簡易而有效的實作原則以提昇科技論文的可讀性。
schedule:
What to be covered in this lecture are:
Week 01 General introduction to the class and requests related to the grade.
Week 02 Basic sentence structure
Week 03 Tour to the library: literature survey …, etc.
Week 04 Basic sentence structure
Week 05 Basic sentence structure
Week 06 Topic study – energy related
Week 07 Topic study – energy related
Week 08 Article structure of typical papers – Theoretical and simulation work
Week 09 Article structure of typical papers – Experimental work
Week 10 Discussion & comments with a Sample article!
Week 11 Comments from Review samples
Week 12 1st presentation group by group
Week 13 Comments from Review samples
Week 14 paper structure – notes to format of the paper
Week 15 seminar 1 by invited speaker
Week 16 seminar 2 by invited speaker
Week 17 2nd presentation group by group
Week 18 2nd presentation group by group and final exam
assessment: presentation 40%, final exam 40%, class and others 20%
